sections.html:
West Valley City is an inner suburb in the northwest Salt Lake Valley, in Salt Lake County, and the second most populous city in Utah. Salt Lake City lies to its north, South Salt Lake to the east, Magna to the west, and Taylorsville and Kearns to the south. The Oquirrh Mountains rise beyond the western edge, and the Jordan River runs along the east.

The 2020 census counted 140,230 residents, up 8.3% from 129,480 in 2010, and the latest estimate is 137,491. That year the city had 42,001 housing units with only 2.9% vacant. The city was formed in 1980 when Hunter, Granger, Chesterfield and Redwood merged, and growth took off in the 1970s, which explains why so many houses are older.

The city is usually described in three areas, and house age differs among them.

  • East (Redwood, Chesterfield and East Granger): mostly brick ranch houses from the 1960s and 1970s, near Valley Fair Mall and the Maverik Center. The Westshire area south of the mall has 160 mid-century modern homes built in the 1960s and 1970s.
  • Central (West Granger and Hunter south of 3100 South, with Lakepark and Westlake Business Park to the north): includes the planned Highbury development in the northwest part.
  • West (West Hunter, Woodhaven and Oquirrh): mostly planned developments from the 1990s and 2000s.

A seller in the East is often selling a brick ranch that is 50 or 60 years old, so roof, plumbing and electrical updates drive the price. Newer planned developments in the West compete on layout and condition instead.

Interstate 215, State Route 172 (5600 West) and State Route 171 (3500 South) are the main roads. The Utah Transit Authority runs an intermodal hub in the city, and West Valley Central station is on the TRAX Green Line.

The 3500 South MAX bus rapid transit line serves the area, and the Midvalley Express links West Valley Central and 2700 West to Taylorsville and on to Murray Central station. Buyers who commute will ask how far the house is from the interstate and the nearest station, so have the answer ready.

The Granite School District covers West Valley City. Granger High School and Hunter High School are both inside the city limits. Because the boundary depends on the address, ask the district which schools your house feeds before you advertise.

Every owner of a rental dwelling needs a current West Valley City business license. An owner with several units needs just one license if they give the city a complete, current list of the units and pay the fees. When a property has more than one owner, each is jointly and severally liable for the fees and any penalties.

The code also sets a rental nuisance standard: more than two police calls for one rental unit in 12 months counts as excessive. An unresolved notice of violation is one with no recorded notice of compliance. Ordinance enforcement handles abatement of unsightly or hazardous property and rental licensing.

  • Check that your rental license is current before listing.
  • Clear any open notice of violation and record the notice of compliance.
  • Gather the unit list if you own more than one rental in the city.

Salt Lake County property tax is due November 30. Anything unpaid is delinquent from December 1. Notices are mailed by November 1, and the 45-day appeal window runs from August 1 to September 15. Parcels more than five years delinquent go to a tax sale in late May.

The 45% exemption means a primary residence is taxed on 55% of market value. A second residence or an unoccupied house is taxed at the full value, so an empty inherited house costs more to carry.

The title company splits the current year's tax between you and the buyer at closing. If a balance is open, it is paid from your proceeds.

Deeds are recorded at the Salt Lake County Recorder, 2001 South State Street, Suite N1-600. The flat fee is $40.00. The deed should list the parcel number and the grantee's mailing address, and it needs a notary acknowledgment. The same office keeps the ownership records the city code uses to identify an owner.

Salt Lake City averages a July high of 94.0 degrees and a January high of 38.6, with about 15.5 inches of precipitation and strong winter inversions. That wears on roofs and heating and cooling systems, and older ranch houses show it first.

Walk the house before an inspector does. Look at the roof, the furnace and air conditioner, the water heater, and the electrical panel and old plumbing in a house from the 1960s or 1970s.

sections.h2: Ways to sell a West Valley City house
sections.html:
You can list, sell on your own, or ask for a cash offer. Cash Home Buyers buys houses here in their present condition, including older ranch houses that need updates. You can request an offer, look over how it was built and decide for yourself.

A cash sale suits a rental with a tenant you do not want to manage, a house with open code violations, an inherited house or a tight timeline. A traditional listing suits a house in good repair when you can wait through showings and a buyer's loan approval.

After you accept an offer, a title company orders the payoff, divides the year's property tax, prepares the deed and files it with the Salt Lake County Recorder. Bring the deed, your latest tax notice and, for a rental, your business license and the unit list. If an open notice of violation is on file, record the notice of compliance first so it does not hold up the sale.

faqs.q: What county is West Valley City in?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County. Property tax, valuation appeals and deed recording go through county offices in Salt Lake City.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in West Valley City?
faqs.a: Salt Lake County property tax is due November 30, and delinquency starts December 1. Notices are mailed by November 1.

faqs.q: Do I need a business license to rent out a house in West Valley City?
faqs.a: Yes. Owners of rental dwelling units need a current West Valley City business license. Owners of several units can use one license with a list of the units.

faqs.q: Which school district serves West Valley City?
faqs.a: The Granite School District. Granger High School and Hunter High School are in the city.

faqs.q: Can I sell a West Valley City house that needs work?
faqs.a: Yes. You can sell as-is, and many owners of older ranch houses use a cash sale to avoid paying for repairs before closing.
